title: Ukun Bloodfeaster
summary: Fight the Bloodfeaster and its maulers while corpses feed a recurring stonemite swarm.
overview: Fight the Bloodfeaster and its maulers while corpses feed a recurring stonemite swarm.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Control the maulers and reduce the corpse-driven add pressure before stonemites overwhelm the raid.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Starting the event removes protection from the Bloodfeaster, maulers and decaying corpses.
Every thirty seconds, surviving corpses are signaled to create pairs of stonemites while the active add count is below thirty-six.
The boss and adds return and clear hate outside their room boundaries.
The forty-five-minute event reset timer pauses while the Bloodfeaster is engaged.

notes: Approval E383. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
